model_choice_note: Document fixes encoder 32/64/128/256, GN8, LeakyReLU .01, decoder d=32/Cg=32/MLP64, eta=1e-3. Unspecified deep relation dimensions/K/epsilon/gamma use legacy development values; GRU retains tested explicit reset-before-linear equations. These are engineering choices pending experiment agreement.
protocol_note: Whole-volume year-specific patient folds, no stratification; full internal-dev every epoch. Cap 500 epochs, minimum 20, patience 20 epochs, accumulated Dice improvement >=0.001. Development choices, not an optimal/frozen paper protocol; official unlabeled validation not used for early stopping.
